# Lean validation: knowledge base

Frameworks for validating ideas with evidence instead of opinion, and for deciding when to pivot.

Based on methods documented by **Eric Ries** in *The Lean Startup*. Independent implementation, no affiliation. For the full reasoning behind each framework, read the book ([theleanstartup.com](http://theleanstartup.com)).

## What is here

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-lean-startup.md` | Build-Measure-Learn, leap-of-faith assumptions, the 5 MVP types, the 10 pivot types, innovation accounting, the 3 growth engines, Five Whys |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-principios-regras.md` | Principles on validation, metrics, experimentation and speed |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-conceitos-definicoes.md` | Concepts and definitions, for semantic search |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-exemplos-aplicados.md` | Applied examples |
| `04-prompt-templates/` | System prompts for the 5 specialist agents in this base |

## Agents

`idea-validator`, `mvp-designer`, `pivot-advisor`, `innovation-accountant`, `growth-engine-selector`
